colombia-documentary-fields.ADDITIONAL: Resolution 2694 already authorized monitoring and verification of the Government–ELN ceasefire. The Council expressed willingness to consider Government–EMC monitoring and verification when the Secretary-General confirms a ceasefire with appropriate verification protocols and takes into account the implementation update of resolution 2694. [ADDITIONAL]
colombia-documentary-fields.overlap: Brazil and A3 support a conditional future Government–EMC verification role, while Resolution 2704 granted no such authority. [BRAZIL, A3, ADDITIONAL]
